descriptions.accounts_get-by-id: Get a single account by id. Required: plan_id, account_id. Returns the account's name, type, on_budget/closed flags, and cleared/uncleared/available balances (both raw milliunits and currency-formatted). Use this when you already have the account id; use accounts_get to list all accounts and find the id first.
descriptions.money-movement-groups_get: List money movement groups for a plan. Required: plan_id. Returns each group's id, month, group_created_at, optional note, and performed_by_user_id, plus server_knowledge for delta sync. Each group aggregates one or more individual money movements (see money-movements_get) that share a money_movement_group_id — use this to see movements batched by the action that created them.
descriptions.money-movements_get: List money movements for a plan. Required: plan_id. A money movement is a record of funds reassigned between budget categories (not a transaction). Returns each movement's id, month, amount (milliunits and currency-formatted), from_category_id, to_category_id, optional note, moved_at timestamp, and money_movement_group_id, plus server_knowledge for delta sync.
descriptions.payee-locations_get: List payee locations for a plan. Required: plan_id. Returns each location's id, payee_id, latitude, longitude, and deleted flag — the geo-coordinates YNAB's mobile apps record when a transaction's payee is entered near a physical location. Use to correlate transactions with where they were made.
descriptions.payees_get-by-id: Get a single payee by id. Required: plan_id, payee_id. Returns the payee's name, transfer_account_id (set only if this is a transfer payee), and deleted flag. Use this when you already have the payee id; use payees_get to list all payees and find the id first.
descriptions.settings_get-plan-by-id: Get a plan's display settings. Required: plan_id. Returns date_format and currency_format (symbol, decimal digits/separator, group separator, ISO code, example format) — the formatting rules YNAB's web and mobile apps use to render dates and amounts for this plan. Use before formatting raw amounts/dates yourself so output matches the user's plan configuration.
descriptions.user_get: Get the authenticated user's id. No parameters. Returns a single uuid identifying the YNAB account the configured token belongs to. Use to confirm which user/token is active, e.g. before an operation whose scope depends on the caller's identity.
